queue.claim: The EXIF FocalLengthIn35mmFilm value is defined on the image diagonal (43.27 mm full-frame diagonal), so a width-based conversion gets the focal length about 4% wrong for 4:3 phone photos. Manufacturers may not follow this consistently.

queue.claim: Adult interpupillary distance has a mean of about 63 mm, most adults fall between roughly 54 and 74 mm, and men average about 2-3 mm wider than women (Dodgson 2004). The note suggests an absolute-scale prior of 63 ± 3.5 mm (1σ).
